description: Create a sector-relative watchlist using sector breadth, stage migration, RS, and price momentum. Variant focus: risk-first review; timeframe: today; response style: action watchlist.

sql_templates.description: Rank sectors by breadth and stage 2 participation
sql_templates.name: sector_ranks
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT 
        sector,
        pct_above_50dma,
        change_5d,
        breadth_signal
    FROM breadth.sector_daily
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily)
),
latest_stage AS (
    SELECT 
        sector,
        AVG(stage_score) AS avg_stage_score
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
    AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
    GROUP BY sector
)
SELECT 
    b.sector,
    b.pct_above_50dma,
    b.change_5d,
    b.breadth_signal,
    s.avg_stage_score
FROM latest_breadth b
JOIN latest_stage s ON b.sector = s.sector
ORDER BY avg_stage_score DESC, b.pct_above_50dma DESC
LIMIT 10;

synthesis_guidance: Provide context-driven rankings and identify actionable sectors for TradingView.
